_thisFileIsFrozen: Hand-written to be a document from BEFORE subclasses existed in the catalog format, and never to be regenerated from the current encoder. A fixture emitted by today's code proves only that today's code agrees with itself; the compatibility claim is about files users already hold, so this one is typed by hand and left alone. If a future change makes this file stop importing, that change has broken every document already in the wild and the test that reads it is supposed to go red.
_whatMakesItLegacy: No element carries a `kind` field, because the format had none to carry. It also omits three fields that were added to the spell record after the earliest documents were written — tags, healing and effectReliabilityCategory — so the defaulting path is exercised too, and it carries an unknown field (_writtenBy) that the parser must drop in silence.
